notes: Hot water / boiler plant point dictionary (reference ch.14, HW-0001..052). Owning equipment: brick:Boiler (verified in Brick 1.4.4; brick:Natural_Gas_Boiler for the gas-fired subclass). Multi-boiler plants bind per boiler; the OAT lockout rule (HW-0003) is plant-level and may bind the OR of boiler statuses plus the lead HW pump. EXPANSION 2026-08-17: six loop-side points added for the PNNL-27338-grounded HW-0004..057 batch (library-authored rules; the reference's ch.14 covers only FC-050..052).

points.name: boiler_status

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty on the Boiler via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Run_Status grep-verified, isPointOf brick:Boiler (verified). Reference Haystack markers: boiler, run. 'Firing' vs 'enabled' matters for HW-0001's start counting: bind the FIRING/flame status where available — an enable status hides burner cycling and undercounts starts (comp_status OR-undercount precedent). Consumed by HW-0001 (edge counting) and HW-0003 (lockout).

points.name: thermal_power

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the Boiler via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Thermal_Power_Sensor grep-verified (carried from hp thermal_power), but marked provisional: few boiler plants meter thermal output directly — usually host-derived from HW flow x deltaT x cp. HW-0002's efficiency numerator; same derivation caveat as chw chiller_tons.

points.name: fuel_power
points.description: Boiler fuel input power (fuel flow x heating value)

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the Boiler via hasProperty

points.notes: No Brick 1.4.4 class for fuel INPUT POWER: brick:Natural_Gas_Usage_Sensor and Natural_Gas_Flow_Sensor (both verified present) meter volume/flow, not kW. Binding derives kW from fuel flow x HHV (or LHV — pick ONE convention and keep the baseline consistent, else HW-0002's efficiency shifts ~10% between conventions). HW-0002's efficiency denominator and its divide guard.

points.name: boiler_firing_rate
points.description: Boiler firing rate (percent of maximum fire)

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the Boiler via hasProperty

points.notes: No Brick 1.4.4 percent-firing-rate class (chiller_load precedent for a null mapping). Modulating burners expose this on the burner controller. HW-0002's single baseline regressor.

points.name: hw_pump_status

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty on the Pump via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Pump_On_Off_Status grep-verified (carried from pmp pump_status). Second branch of HW-0003's lockout OR — pumps circulating above lockout waste energy even with the boiler off.

points.name: oat

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the outdoor air connection point

points.notes: Carried from the ahu/erv dictionaries (brick:Outside_Air_Temperature_Sensor, grep-verified there). HW-0003's lockout comparator; its diagnosis list includes an OAT sensor reading low — pair with sensor-health rules when phase 3 opens.

points.notes: brick:Hot_Water_Supply_Temperature_Sensor grep-verified. HW-0004's delta-T minuend and HW-0007's comparator.

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the equipment via hasProperty

points.name: boiler_cmd
points.description: Boiler enable command (true = commanded to fire)

s223.pattern: EnumeratedActuatableProperty on the Boiler via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Start_Stop_Command attached via isPointOf to brick:Boiler (pump_cmd precedent). The command HALF of the boiler_status pair; HW-0009 proof-of-operation compares the two. Bind the plant-level enable the BAS actually writes — a lead/lag sequencer's internal stage command is upstream of what this point means.
